decisions.reason: Existing fail-closed cost, quote-freshness, liquidity, sellability and simulation gates reduce unsupported execution. KEEP requires no code change, deployment or safety modification.
required_tests: Replay timestamped shadow opportunities without future leakage and verify that missing costs, stale quotes, failed simulations, failed sellability checks and non-positive executable edge always make the event ineligible.

decisions.reason: The architecture indicates potentially invalid aggregation of unlike native units, but only one valid agent supports the change and fresh runtime reconciliation is unavailable.
required_tests: Run a non-signing parallel scorecard keyed by strategy, chain and version for at least 100 reconciled outcomes per strategy-chain pair over 30 days and three volatility or gas regimes.
Verify capital-at-risk, proceeds, all fees, failed-attempt costs and contemporaneous valuation are complete and that the lower confidence bound of money-weighted net return is positive.

decisions.reason: A current executable-edge adapter is plausible, but the deterministic gate lacks two independent supporting agents and there is no fresh size-specific Solana runtime evidence.
required_tests: Collect at least 500 timestamped leader events over 30 days, including 200 complete round-trip quote and simulation pairs and at least 50 rejected sellability cases.
Verify stale quotes, missing sell quotes, failed simulations, excessive impact, unresolved token-account state and non-positive net edge fail closed.

decisions.reason: Deterministic separation of strategy losses from execution failures would improve evidence quality, but only one valid agent supports implementation and measured reconciliation is absent.
required_tests: Reconcile every shadow decision through quote, simulation, submission, receipt, balances and close state for 30 days.
Verify every submitted attempt has a reproducible primary cause, paid-cost accounting, final disposition and inventory state, with manual review of at least 50 failures and 50 economic losses.

summary: Only GPT supplied a valid report; Copilot was undelivered and Gemini invalid. Architecture-only evidence is stale and contains no fresh runtime forensics. Preserve existing fail-closed controls, but defer all proposed code changes pending independent support and measured shadow evidence.
